name: JM Owner Vault
purpose: Add explicit private durable owner storage behind the existing local-first Owner Room without turning private custody into public publication.

storage.stored_bodies: standalone HTML bytes explicitly synced by the owner
storage.snapshot_rule: metadata/state snapshots do not duplicate HTML object bytes

laws: Nothing uploads without explicit owner sync
Private durable copy is not public publication
Identical bytes are not identical identity: every independently intended body use is preserved
Only exact same-source-instance and same-bytes retries are idempotent
No older intended body is silently evicted at index capacity

security_boundary.session_auth: X-JM-Owner-Key entered by the owner and held only in browser sessionStorage
security_boundary.future_upgrade: Cloudflare Access identity/JWT gate may replace the session key without changing the storage contract

publication_boundary: R2 owner-vault objects remain private working custody. Deliberate promotion to a canonical public repository body continues through the governed permanent HTML body pipeline and separate deployment proof.

current_source_policy.source_instance_identity: Existing local mounted-body id; preserves separate intended uses even with identical HTML bytes, name and filename
current_source_policy.edit_revision: Same mounted-body id with changed bytes appends a new version; previousVersionId links the ancestor
current_source_policy.legacy_missing_source_id: Preserve as a distinct record; do not deduplicate by hash alone
current_source_policy.body_bytes_storage: Separate R2 object per distinct intended use; no physical deduplication of separately purposeful copies
